imageGeneration.title: Image Generation
imageGeneration.description: Configure one custom OpenAI Images-compatible endpoint for the image_generate tool. It is independent from chat providers.

imageGeneration.testPrompt: A small red circle on a white background, minimal flat illustration.

toast.saveBeforeTest: Save settings before running a test

openAiRelay.title: Custom image endpoint
openAiRelay.description: Send image generation to a dedicated OpenAI Images-compatible endpoint (/v1/images/generations). This does not change any chat provider.
openAiRelay.baseUrlHint: e.g. https://api.example.com/v1 — /v1 is appended automatically when omitted.
openAiRelay.apiKeyPlaceholderConfigured: Already configured — leave blank to keep
openAiRelay.modelHint: Enter only the model id, for example gpt-image-2. Do not include provider/model.

errors.invalidTimeout: Timeout must be a positive number
errors.relayModelInvalid: Enter only the model name, for example gpt-image-2. Do not include provider/model.

embeddings.title: Embedding Models
embeddings.description: Configure OpenClaw memory-search embeddings under agents.defaults.memorySearch.
embeddings.enabledDesc: Use embeddings for semantic recall from memory files and configured transcript sources.
embeddings.providerHint: Use a built-in adapter such as openai, gemini, ollama, local, or a configured models.providers.<id> entry.
embeddings.modelHint: Leave blank to use the provider default.
embeddings.clearConfirmMessage: This removes the embedding provider and advanced memory-search fields managed on this page from agents.defaults.memorySearch.

remote.title: OpenAI-compatible endpoint
remote.description: Used when provider is openai-compatible, or when you need a dedicated /v1/embeddings server.

local.title: Local GGUF embeddings
local.description: Used by the local llama.cpp embedding provider.

advanced.sourcesDescription: Choose which memory surfaces are indexed and add extra collection paths.
advanced.sourcesHint: One per line or comma separated: memory, sessions.
advanced.extraPathsHint: Additional files or folders to index.
advanced.qmdCollectionsHint: JSON array with path, optional name, and optional pattern.
advanced.remoteDescription: Tune custom headers, immediate requests, and remote batch indexing behavior.
advanced.remoteHeadersHint: JSON object of extra headers for embedding requests.
advanced.multimodalDescription: Control media indexing, experimental session memory, and sync triggers.
advanced.storageDescription: Configure the index store, optional vector extension, and text chunk sizing.
advanced.queryDescription: Tune retrieval limits, hybrid scoring, MMR, temporal decay, and cache size.

errors.remoteBaseUrlRequired: Embedding Base URL is required for openai-compatible providers
errors.positiveInteger: Numeric fields must be positive integers
errors.nonNegativeInteger: Numeric fields must be zero or positive integers

errors.source: Sources can only be memory or sessions
